intro: Across aviation, banking, communications, critical infrastructure, and education, six articles on dll-sideloading span 13 April 2026 to 6 October 2026. Five are rated high severity. The activity touches Africa, Asia, China, East asia, and India. CL-STA-1178, HelloNet, and LOTUSLITE each appear among the top threat actors tracked in this tag. The collection covers campaigns affecting organisations in these sectors and regions, with the earliest reporting in April and the most recent in October.
